CommitContainer.description_en: Calls the CommitContainer operation to create an asynchronous task that saves a specified container in an Elastic Container Instance (ECI) instance as an image and pushes the image to an image repository in Alibaba Cloud Container Registry (ACR)
CommitContainer.description_zh: 调用CommitContainer接口创建异步任务，将ECI实例中的指定容器保存为镜像，并推送至阿里云ACR的镜像仓库中

CopyDataCache.description_en: Copies a data cache from one region to another
CopyDataCache.description_zh: 将数据缓存从一个地域拷贝到另一个地域

CreateContainerGroup.description_en: Creates an Elastic Container Instance (ECI), which is a container group
CreateContainerGroup.description_zh: 调用CreateContainerGroup创建一个ECI实例（即容器组）

CreateImageCache.description_en: Creates an image cache to accelerate image pulling and reduce startup time for subsequent Elastic Container Instance (ECI) instance creation
CreateImageCache.description_zh: 调用CreateImageCache接口创建一个镜像缓存，以便后续创建ECI实例可以加速镜像拉取，减少实例启动耗时

CreateInstanceOpsTask.description_en: Calls CreateInstanceOpsTask to create an operations and maintenance (O&M) task
CreateInstanceOpsTask.description_zh: 调用CreateInstanceOpsTask创建一个运维任务

CreateVirtualNode.description_en: Creates a virtual node (VNode) to connect to a self-managed Kubernetes cluster, enabling the cluster to scale resources to Elastic Container Instance (ECI)
CreateVirtualNode.description_zh: 创建一个虚拟节点（VNode），用于对接自建Kubernetes集群，使其可以扩展资源到ECI

DeleteContainerGroup.description_en: Deletes an Elastic Container Instance (ECI) instance

DeleteImageCache.description_zh: 调用DeleteImageCache删除一个镜像缓存

DeleteVirtualNode.description_zh: 调用DeleteVirtualNode删除一个虚拟节点

DescribeAvailableResource.description_en: Queries the ECS instance families available for sale in a specified region and zone
DescribeAvailableResource.description_zh: 调用DescribeAvailableResource查询指定地域和可用区下可售ECS实例规格族

DescribeCommitContainerTask.description_en: Queries the details of a CommitContainer task

DescribeContainerGroupEvents.description_en: Queries event information for multiple Elastic Container Instance (ECI) instances in a batch
DescribeContainerGroupEvents.description_zh: 调用DescribeContainerGroupEvents批量查询ECI实例的事件信息

DescribeContainerGroupMetric.description_en: Queries the monitoring data of an Elastic Container Instance (ECI)
DescribeContainerGroupMetric.description_zh: 调用DescribeContainerGroupMetric查询一个ECI实例的监控数据

DescribeContainerGroupPrice.description_en: Queries the price of an Elastic Container Instance (ECI) instance

DescribeContainerGroupStatus.description_en: You can call DescribeContainerGroupStatus to perform a batch query on the status of multiple Elastic Container Instance (ECI) instances

DescribeContainerGroups.description_en: Queries information about Elastic Container Instance (ECI) instances in batches
DescribeContainerGroups.description_zh: 调用DescribeContainerGroups批量查询ECI实例的信息

DescribeContainerLog.description_en: Queries the logs of a container in a container group
DescribeContainerLog.description_zh: 调用DescribeContainerLog获取容器组内某个容器的日志信息

DescribeDataCaches.description_en: Queries the details of one or more data caches

DescribeImageCaches.description_en: Queries the details of one or more image caches
DescribeImageCaches.description_zh: 调用DescribeImageCaches批量查询镜像缓存信息

DescribeInstanceOpsRecords.description_en: You can call DescribeInstanceOpsRecords to query the O&M task records for an instance
DescribeInstanceOpsRecords.description_zh: 调用DescribeInstanceOpsRecords查询运维任务信息

DescribeMultiContainerGroupMetric.description_en: You can call the DescribeContainerGroupMetric operation to query the monitoring data of an ECI instance
DescribeMultiContainerGroupMetric.description_zh: 调用DescribeContainerGroupMetric查询一个ECI实例的监控数据

DescribeRegions.description_en: Queries the regions and zones supported by Elastic Container Instance
DescribeRegions.description_zh: 查询弹性容器实例支持的地域和可用区信息

DescribeVirtualNodes.description_en: Queries the details of one or more virtual nodes
DescribeVirtualNodes.description_zh: 调用DescribeVirtualNodes批量查询虚拟节点的详细信息

ExecContainerCommand.description_en: Executes a command in a container
ExecContainerCommand.description_zh: 调用ExecContainerCommand在容器内部执行命令

ListTagResources.description_en: You can call the ListTagResources operation to query the tags that are attached to ECI resources
ListTagResources.description_zh: 调用ListTagResources查询ECI资源绑定的标签信息

ListUsage.description_en: Call the ListUsage operation to query the privilege quotas in a specified region. The response returns the used amount and the upper limit of each quota
ListUsage.description_zh: 调用ListUsage查询指定地域的权益配额，包括已使用量和使用上限

ResizeContainerGroupVolume.description_en: You can call the ResizeContainerGroupVolume operation to resize a disk volume mounted to a specified Elastic Container Instance (ECI)
ResizeContainerGroupVolume.description_zh: 调用ResizeContainerGroupVolume扩容指定ECI实例挂载的云盘数据卷

RestartContainerGroup.description_en: The RestartContainerGroup operation restarts an ECI instance

TagResources.description_en: Attaches tags to the specified Elastic Container Instance (ECI) resources
TagResources.description_zh: 调用TagResources为指定的ECI资源绑定标签

UntagResources.description_en: Removes tags from the specified Elastic Container Instance (ECI) resources
UntagResources.description_zh: 调用UntagResources为指定的ECI资源解绑标签

UpdateImageCache.description_zh: 调用UpdateImageCache更新一个镜像缓存

UpdateVirtualNode.description_en: You can call the UpdateVirtualNode operation to update the properties of a virtual node
UpdateVirtualNode.description_zh: 调用UpdateVirtualNode更新一个虚拟节点的属性

华东5（南京-本地地域）已关停
